overall_summary: Analysis of 25 short-form videos reveals that content focused on 'self respect' combined with modern, tactile smartphone metaphors (deleting chats, blue ticks, keyboard memory) consistently achieves higher view counts (30-41 views) compared to abstract emotional topics like 'rat ke khayal' or general 'bewafai' which underperform (<20 views). However, overall channel engagement (likes/comments) is currently near zero, indicating a need for stronger emotional punch and a clear call-to-action in future iterations.

winning_patterns.evidence: Videos focusing on specific UI/UX actions like 'ब्लू टिक्स', 'चैट डिलीट', or 'स्टेटस लिस्ट' (e.g., wFimeeP_aVc with 35 views, AfaLxMy6FMY with 41 views, rwOUYo_hayQ with 41 views) outperform abstract concepts.
winning_patterns.action: Continue anchoring emotional heartbreak into tangible everyday digital micro-actions.

winning_patterns.evidence: Framing pain as a choice of self-preservation rather than victimization drives better baseline viewership.
winning_patterns.action: Ensure captions and hooks emphasize personal boundaries over helpless weeping.

weak_patterns.evidence: Topics like 'रात के ख्याल' (uIbMpCjVutQ) and generic waiting scenarios received very low views (6-8 views).
weak_patterns.action: Avoid passive descriptions of time passing without a concrete triggering object or action.
